description:
The linked artifacts of the repository-state quality container reach the archive through the product's own execution path, and the plan warnings the run reports are recorded for the citation work that follows.

## Background

Running the cleanup through archival execution rather than by hand is the point: an earlier hand-rolled move skipped the planner's reference remapping, left a document reference dangling, and forced a hand repair of a validation failure. Executing the real mechanism exercises the remapping on real artifacts and makes the run its own acceptance evidence.

This is the single execution over container `1cc809de`, whose destination directory is `dev/archive/1cc809de-repository-state-quality`. Its plan currently schedules 2 artifacts for relocation and 1 for copying, and reports 3 selected roots that the area classification and blocker repairs landing earlier turn into ordinary artifacts.

The enumerated artifact set is the plan's current one. A classification change landing before this run can move an entry between relocation and copying and can admit an entry the current plan reports as a blocked selected root, so the execution reads its own plan rather than a frozen list.

Relocation is not the only outcome. An artifact whose owner sits wholly inside this container's subtree relocates and leaves nothing behind, while an artifact an owner outside that subtree also claims, or one that sits in a permanent area, is copied into the archive with its source retained. A retained source is a read-only input of this run rather than something it writes. The read set is the single artifact `dev/studies/cdc840ad-audit-2026-07-23.md`. The declared footprint names only what this run writes, which is the destination directory it creates plus the sources it relocates. The footprint also names the 17 artifacts under `dev/presentations`, which this plan today leaves in place because that area is unclassified and which this run relocates once the area classification lands.

A measurement record under this container's study subtree is read at runtime by a committed self-test script. Its document reference is pinned to a commit before this run, which is what makes the mechanism retain it in place instead of relocating it.

An execution refuses to run unless its plan is eligible, so an ineligible preview is a stop rather than a partial move. The run reports plan warnings naming in-content citations of the artifacts it relocates; those warnings are the input to the citation work that follows and are recorded rather than discarded.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The container previews an eligible plan before its execution runs.
- [hard] REQ-02: Every artifact the plan schedules for relocation is present at its destination under `dev/archive/1cc809de-repository-state-quality` and absent from its source path.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every artifact the plan schedules for copying is present at its destination under `dev/archive/1cc809de-repository-state-quality` and retained at its source path.
- [hard] REQ-04: The relocation was performed by the archival execution path, evidenced by the recorded execution events and the container marker in the destination directory.
- [hard] REQ-05: The plan warnings naming in-content citations of the artifacts this run relocates are recorded.
- [hard] REQ-06: Artifacts owned by live issues are left where they are.
- [hard] REQ-07: Whole-repository validation passes after the run and every document reference resolves.
title: Archive the repository-state quality container's linked artifacts
